# Provenance of the Lean sources

This file lists where each of the 377 Lean source files of this repository comes from. It was
generated by comparing the files with their sources; the per-file headers in `OAI/` say the same.

| Origin | Files |
| --- | ---: |
| Adapted from [openai/math](https://github.com/openai/math) (Apache-2.0) | 194 |
| Taken unchanged from the NP-completeness foundation NPCompleteness-Lean4 (Apache-2.0) | 75 |
| Written for this project | 108 |

## 1. Adapted from the OpenAI mathematics repository (194 files)

Source: <https://github.com/openai/math>, commit `adc7f1241b42e322a6451854ab7e4b4c146bf78a`,
licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (copy in `OAI/LICENSE`). The upstream repository has no
`NOTICE` file. Every file below begins with a comment naming its upstream file and stating the
changes made to it. The change common to all of them is the conversion to the Lean module system
(`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); in 97 files `private` modifiers
were also removed. The files with further changes are:

* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/Foundations/Conditioning.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); adjusted for Lean v4.35.0-rc2.
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/Machines/FinalCNFMachineLemmas.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); binder type made explicit in the statement of `unaryBits_relation` for the module system.
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/Machines/MachineRegularTableTrace.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); `private` modifiers removed; the duplicate private helper `joinTrace` is dropped (the identical, now public, one from `MachineRegularTable` is used).
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/Machines/PoweringMachineVertex.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); `private` modifiers removed; proof of `rowBits_eq` adjusted for the module system.
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/PCP/FinalTableFormula.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); the clause-gap theorem is restated in count form (`clauseCount`) so that this file no longer imports the unrelated later stage.
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/PCP/GapTheorem.lean`: only the part about the 3-CNF gap map is kept (the later stage of the source file is dropped), the clause gap is stated as an inequality between natural numbers, and the file is converted to the Lean module system.
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/PCP/PreprocessingInternalRows.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); `private` modifiers removed; proof of `reverseIndex_internal` adjusted for the module system.
* `OAI/Computability/UniqueGames/PCP/RawInitialTablesLemmas.lean`: converted to the Lean module system (`module` header, `public import`, `@[expose] public section`); `sizeFactor` is defined through the opaque `sizeFactorData` with the equation `sizeFactor_eq`, and the proofs of `sizeFactor_positive` and `build_size_le` treat the large constants as opaque (the NanoDa checker overflowed its stack when unfolding the original definition).
